antiRegressions: Do not re-introduce Bearer authorization headers; project migrated to HttpOnly session cookies.
Do not use sync fs operations in realtime socket handlers; always use async fs/promises.
Do not wipe dist/ folder while docker watcher is attached; use incremental esbuild re-emit.
Do not create postcss.config.js for Tailwind 4; use @import 'tailwindcss' directly in index.css.

memories.title: HttpOnly Cookie Auth Migration
memories.content: Backend migrated from Authorization Bearer to HttpOnly cookie 'session_token'. Frontend requests must specify withCredentials: true.

memories.title: Prisma & PostgreSQL Connection Pool Limits
memories.content: Neon/PgBouncer pooler port 6543 requires ?sslmode=require&pgbouncer=true. Max connections hard-capped at 15 to avoid deadlock.

memories.title: Vite Tailwind 4 Migration Fix
memories.content: Tailwind v4 must use @import 'tailwindcss'; directly in index.css. Do NOT generate postcss.config.js or tailwind.config.js as it breaks Vite 6 build.

decisionNodes.title: Goal Initiated: Security Hardening
decisionNodes.description: User requested migrating REST API auth from localStorage Bearer tokens to signed HttpOnly cookies.
decisionNodes.outcome: Task planned into 3 milestones: Middleware, Login endpoint, Client interceptor.

decisionNodes.title: Milestone 1: Cookie Middleware Added
decisionNodes.description: Installed cookie-parser and verified verifySession() reading req.cookies['session_id'].
decisionNodes.outcome: Middleware test suite green. Committed into Warm Episodic Memory.
decisionNodes.antiRegressionRule: Auth token lives in cookie header, NOT req.headers.authorization.

decisionNodes.title: Attempted Sub-task: Cross-Domain Cookie Drop
decisionNodes.description: Agent attempted withCredentials: false on billing requests. Browser dropped cookies due to CORS.
decisionNodes.outcome: Dead-end identified: SameSite=None + Secure=true required for cross-origin staging.
decisionNodes.antiRegressionRule: Always set withCredentials: true on axios instance; do not revert.

decisionNodes.title: Governor Interception: Regression Blocked
decisionNodes.description: Agent context degraded and LLM generated code reading 'req.headers.authorization'. MemGovernor intercepted before tool execution!
decisionNodes.outcome: Agent corrected in-flight to use req.cookies['session_id']. Zero regression introduced.

decisionNodes.title: Task Finalized: Clean Context Rollup
decisionNodes.description: All endpoints verified. Ephemeral tool outputs collapsed into a 240-token episodic summary.
decisionNodes.outcome: Repository ready for production deployment with pristine commit history.

decisionNodes.title: Automated Circuit Breaker: Doom Loop Intercepted
decisionNodes.description: Interrupted circular repetition: Repeated tool execution 'run_command' on target 'npm test' without successful resolution.
decisionNodes.outcome: Automated halt triggered to prevent runaway token burning.
